name: robots/acutronicrobotics__gym-gazebo2
title: gym-gazebo2 MARA simulated arm
intro: gym-gazebo2 MARA simulated arm, adapted from acutronicrobotics/gym-gazebo2. It reads `observation`, `reward`, `terminated`, `truncated` and 4 more; runs `step`, `reset` and `seed`. `step`: advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
